text:
alex: Hey team — trying to build a tiny Remix-run starter that demonstrates LangChain + Redwood hosted API for embeddings + RAG. Hitting an auth/retry oddity when running on Vercel Edge (edge runtime). The SDK call fails with 401 but retries succeed; seems like ephemeral token refresh race. Repro steps:

```
// loader.ts
const res = await redwood.llm.generate({ model: 'redwood/gpt-4o-mini' })
```

Anyone seen this or have a minimal starter pattern?

marta: Hmm, can you paste the exact error? Is this the JS SDK from @devex-sdk or the fetch wrapper?

alex: Error is `401 Unauthorized` at first request, then `200` on immediate retry. No explicit refresh hook in code. Using client-side fetch inside edge loader. Example log:

```
[loader] fetch /api/llm -> 401
[loader] retry -> 200
```

julia: Sounds like we saw this in Next edge SSR too — token provider returning a short-lived token that isn't ready at cold start. Workaround: explicitly call await authClient.getToken() during startup and attach header. Also ensure fetch doesn't run in parallel during warmup.

alex: @julia thanks — I tried prefetching token in a root loader and it mostly fixes it. Two follow-ups: (1) Is stream/ReadableStream supported in edge runtime for the SDK? I need streaming chat in Remix. (2) Any recommended minimal repo layout for LangChain tools + eval harness to include in devex samples?

marta: (1) SDK streaming is behind the node adapter; doesn't work in some edge runtimes yet. Workaround: use fetch to the hosted API directly and pipe the response as a stream: `fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood/gpt-4o-mini', prompt: '...' }) })` then use response.body as a stream in the edge. (2) For eval harness, we have a tiny repo `devex/remix-llm-eval` that wires up a prompts.json + simple mocha tests. I'll DM the link.

devex-bot: Filed issue DEVX-8421: 'Edge SDK auth race on cold start' — team assigned @infra. Tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx/issues/8421 :thumbsup: 

alex: Great — I'll add a minimal starter PR that uses the fetch streaming workaround + prefetch token. Will add an eval test that runs headless against the hosted sandbox. Any naming preference for the sample? `remix-langchain-rag-starter`?

marta: Love that name. Keep it <= 3 pages in README and include a tiny prompt set + CI job that runs the eval in GitHub Actions. :sparkles:

julia: If you want, I can review the CI eval config tomorrow.

alex: Perfect — thanks all!
